children: Platform continues to advance integrated capabilities, scenario adaptability and enterprise deployment readiness to support potential scaled commercial applications
SHENZHEN, China, Sept. 16, 2026
-- Jiuzi Holdings, Inc.

("Jiuzi" or the "Company") today provided an update on the latest progress of its AI intelligent imaging and data platform. Following the Company's previously announced development roadmap and commercial deployment preparations, Jiuzi is continuing to advance platform-level capability integration, system stability evaluation, scenario adaptability and enterprise deployment readiness, with the objective of supporting the evolution of its AI intelligent imaging technology from individual functional modules toward a more integrated enterprise-level solution.

The Company stated that its current focus is expanding from the development of individual AI recognition capabilities toward system-level coordination and practical scenario adaptability. Around core capabilities including real-time image recognition, dynamic scene analysis, automated content tagging, intelligent image filtering, multimodal data fusion and cloud-based data processing, Jiuzi is continuing to optimize coordination among different platform modules and evaluate the platform's adaptability under multi-scenario, high-concurrency and continuous-operation conditions.

Jiuzi believes enterprise demand for AI intelligent imaging technology is gradually shifting from isolated algorithm capabilities toward more complete platform-based solutions. For practical commercial deployment, the Company believes that system stability, data-processing efficiency, cross-scenario adaptability, deployment flexibility and compatibility with existing enterprise IT systems are increasingly important alongside algorithmic accuracy.
In response to these trends, the Company is continuing to refine the overall architecture of its AI intelligent imaging platform and is currently advancing work in the following areas:
Platform-level capability integration: continuing to integrate image recognition, scene understanding, data processing and decision-support modules to improve coordination across platform functions.
Multi-scenario adaptability evaluation: assessing the platform's ability to support image acquisition, real-time analysis and data processing across different enterprise operating environments.
Multimodal data processing: further integrating video, image and structured data to support more complex enterprise intelligent-analysis applications.

System stability and scalability: continuing to evaluate platform performance under high-concurrency, real-time processing and extended-operation conditions in preparation for potential larger-scale deployment.

Enterprise deployment readiness: optimizing standardized interfaces, deployment workflows and solution architecture with the goal of reducing future integration and adaptation costs across different customer environments.

Commercial application evaluation: continuing to assess potential applications in enterprise operations, security management, content analysis, digital management and other intelligent imaging scenarios.

Through these efforts, the Company is seeking to further develop the AI intelligent imaging platform from a collection of technical capabilities into a more unified, modular and deployable platform architecture. Jiuzi intends to improve the platform's practical usability in enterprise environments through continued technical evaluation and scenario assessment, while establishing a clearer technical foundation for potential future commercial deployment.

At the same time, the Company continues to evaluate demand for AI intelligent imaging solutions across different industry scenarios. As enterprise data volumes continue to increase and video, image and structured data become more important to business operations, Jiuzi believes that platform-based AI solutions capable of supporting real-time perception, data analytics and business decision support may have broader application potential.

The Company plans to continue developing its AI intelligent imaging business through a phased and prudent approach. As platform maturity, scenario adaptability and commercial models continue to be evaluated, Jiuzi expects to assess additional opportunities for project deployment and commercial cooperation with technology partners, enterprise customers and other ecosystem participants.

The Company emphasized that the relevant work remains in ongoing development, evaluation and commercial deployment preparation stages. The ultimate scale of deployment, customer adoption and commercial contribution, if any, will depend on technical progress, market demand, partner execution, project implementation and other commercial factors.
